verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents an official MCP server that brings its analytics into AI tools like Claude and Cursor. It also has a Dashboard REST API, but that API only returns dashboard data as JSON. Its Wizard CLI can produce a first dashboard from one terminal command. None of this shows an agent creating and configuring a key-metrics dashboard end-to-end through the API or MCP; the MCP pages present conversational answers as a replacement for configuring dashboards. Missing for 10: documented dashboard/chart creation endpoints in the API, MCP tools that create or edit dashboards, any hands-on evidence of an agent building a dashboard end-to-end.
